documents.title: Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Notice Of The 01/2026-27 Extraordinary General Meeting
Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Signpost India reported its Q4 and FY26 financial results during its maiden earnings call, highlighting a revenue growth of 27% to INR576 crores and an operating EBITDA increase of 65% to INR147 crores for the full year. Management discussed their strategic transformation, expansion into 32 cities with transit and digital assets, and direct engagement with long-term brand advertisers. The company provided an outlook for FY27 anticipating double-figure revenue growth and EBITDA margins in the 25% to 27% range supported by a capex plan of INR60 crores to INR75 crores. Additionally, management addressed cash flow collection bottlenecks and outlined plans to improve working capital cycles by Q3 of FY27. Signpost India reported financial and operational results for the quarter and financial year ended March 31, 2026.

guidance.claim: The growth in FY27 will be underpinned by a capex of INR60 crores to INR75 crores.
guidance.quote: The growth will be underpinned by a capex of around INR60 crores to INR75 crores this year across the infrastructure and capacity expansion along with the technology implementation.

guidance.claim: Management guided to more than 20% revenue growth in FY27 at EBITDA margins in the range of 25% to 27%.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, we are guiding to more than 20% revenue growth in FY27 at EBITDA margins in the range of 25% to 27%, underpinned by a planned strategic capex of ₹60–70 crore across infrastructure, capacity and technology.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident in delivering high-teen revenue growth momentum supported by ongoing advertiser engagement and recently activated markets.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, we remain confident on the medium-term outlook, supported by sustained advertiser engagement, deepening client relationships and the gradual ramp-up of recently activated markets, enabling us to deliver high-teen revenue growth momentum.

demand_outlook.claim: Brands are increasingly engaging for continuous campaigns across 6 to 12 months rather than short periods.
Management noted increasing urbanisation and digital-OOH tailwinds.
demand_outlook.quote: With increasing urbanisation and digital-OOH tailwinds in our favour, we remain confident of delivering sustainable, profitable growth and creating enduring value for all our stakeholders.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its footprint from 4 cities to 32 cities, adding 866,000 square feet during the year.
capex_expansion.quote: Our footprint has grown from four cities which was there when we listed in 2024, now we have grown to 32 cities, adding around 866,000 square feet in this year, where across metro, transit, and digital assets, including significant Bangalore Metro network expansion, the addition of electric premium bus fleets across Mumbai, Hyderabad, Goa.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans a capex of INR60 crores to INR75 crores for the year across infrastructure, capacity expansion, and technology.
capex_expansion.quote: The growth will be underpinned by a capex of around INR60 crores to INR75 crores this year across the infrastructure and capacity expansion along with the technology implementation.

capex_expansion.claim: The company planned a strategic capex of ₹60-70 crore across infrastructure, capacity, and technology for FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we are guiding to more than 20% revenue growth in FY27 at EBITDA margins in the range of 25% to 27%, underpinned by a planned strategic capex of ₹60–70 crore across infrastructure, capacity and technology.

capex_expansion.claim: The company activated nine new cities and added over 866,000 square feet of premium media inventory.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year we materially widened our national footprint, activating nine new cities — including Ayodhya, Lucknow, Agra, Chandigarh, Guwahati, Kolkata and Chennai — and adding over 866,000 square feet of premium media inventory across metro, transit and digital assets.

margins_costs.claim: Operating EBITDA margin expanded by close to 600 basis points to 25.5% in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Operating EBITDA increased 65% to INR147 crores with EBITDA margin expanding by close to 600 basis points to 25.5% from 19.6% in FY25.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin for the full year improved to 40.9%.
margins_costs.quote: Gross profit rose 33% to INR236 crores with the gross margin improving to 40.9%.

margins_costs.claim: Management sees a scope for a 7% to 8% reduction in costs in the coming year without hurting the top line.
margins_costs.quote: Definitely we internally deliberated around this and we see a scope of around 7% to 8% where we can see a reduction in coming year as far as the cost is concerned without hurting the top line.

margins_costs.claim: Operating EBITDA rose 65% to ₹147 crore, expanding the EBITDA margin by close to 600 basis points to 25.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue from operations grew 27% to ₹576 crore, while Operating EBITDA rose 65% to ₹147 crore — expanding our EBITDA margin by close to 600 basis points to 25.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Operating costs remained largely stable despite strong revenue growth, allowing fixed-cost leverage to improve profitability.
margins_costs.quote: Despite strong revenue growth, operating costs remained largely stable, enabling fixed-cost leverage to translate incremental revenues meaningfully into profitability.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q3FY26 reached Rs. 38 crore with a margin of 27%, which is expected to remain sustainable.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for Q3FY26 more than doubled year-on-year to ₹38 crore, with margins at 27% - which is expected to remain sustainable, supported by the current operating architecture and business mix.

orders_capacity.claim: The company manages over 15,000 assets across more than 32 cities and serves over 1,600 active advertisers.
orders_capacity.quote: Today we manage over 12,500 assets (ERRATA: Wrongly spoken as 12,500 assets. To be considered as 15,000 assets) across more than 32 cities, serves over 1,600 active advertisers, reach upwards of 60 million people every month.

orders_capacity.claim: Existing contracts carry an average remaining tenure of roughly 14 years.
orders_capacity.quote: And our contracts carry an average remaining tenure of roughly around 14 years, giving our revenue a long visible recurring quality.

risks_headwinds.claim: Multi-city campaigns introduced challenges and stress related to regional office compliances and invoice consolidation.
risks_headwinds.quote: And while completing that, it takes humongous time and energy.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company targets 20% plus revenue growth in the coming year.
management_commitments.quote: Which is a great advantage for us to start our year and get the assurity of that number in first 2 months and there is a probability of similar growth what we achieved this year which will be 20% plus this again in the coming year.

management_commitments.claim: Management guided to more than 20% revenue growth at EBITDA margins of 25% to 27% for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we are guiding to more than 20% revenue growth in FY27 at EBITDA margins in the range of 25% to 27%, underpinned by a planned strategic capex of ₹60–70 crore across infrastructure, capacity and technology.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated an expectation for EBITDA margins to remain sustainable around 27% backed by the current operating architecture and business mix.
management_commitments.quote: EBITDA for Q3FY26 more than doubled year-on-year to ₹38 crore, with margins at 27% - which is expected to remain sustainable, supported by the current operating architecture and business mix.

management_commitments.claim: Management expressed confidence in delivering high-teen revenue growth momentum based on the medium-term outlook.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we remain confident on the medium-term outlook, supported by sustained advertiser engagement, deepening client relationships and the gradual ramp-up of recently activated markets, enabling us to deliver high-teen revenue growth momentum.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
